text:
omar (sales): Heads up — HelioTrade wants an on-prem private deployment (VPC+HSM) for Q3. Support flagged latency and compliance needs.

maria (pm): thanks. can you paste the ask + must-haves? we need scope to triage into backlog.

omar (sales): copy:
- data residency in EU
- HSM integration for key material
- dedicated GPU pool, 50 rps sustained
- STS-based SSO + audit logs

kevin (se): quick q: do they expect full offline air-gapped option or just VPC w/ no internet egress?

omar (sales): VPC w/ strict outbound controls. eventual airgap maybe later — first priority is EU isolation + HSM.

sophia (eng): initial feasibility: HSM + KMS ok via our KMS plugin but HSM requires updates: PKCS#11 support + auth flow. estimate 3 wk for infra work, 2 wk for integration testing.

maria (pm): rough end-to-end timeline?

sophia (eng): dev + infra: 5 wks, QA + compliance signoff: 2 wks, rollout staging->prod: 1 wk. total ~8 weeks if no blockers.

kevin (se): dependencies: customer-provided network peering, HSM credentials, certs, and SRE change window. I'll list:
- VPC peering + route table config
- HSM appliance access & PKCS#11 creds
- Customer IAM mapping for STS
- Approved runbook for incident ops

infra-bot: deploy checklist created: RDW-3219

maria (pm): decision points: (1) HSM scope (managed vs bring-your-own), (2) SLA tier (Dedicated vs Private), (3) rollout gating: perf test thresholds.

omar (sales): customer prefers BYO-HSM and Dedicated SLA.

maria (pm): ok. I'll create intake ticket and assign owners. quick triage:
- Priority: P1 (enterprise security)
- Required for backlog: architecture spec, compliance checklist, customer network diagram, legal terms
- Target milestone: VM in staging w/ HSM integration demo by 2025-07-25

kevin (se): I'll spin up a spike branch to validate PKCS#11 inside our runtime — ETA 5d.

sophia (eng): flag: quantization/throughput optimizations might be needed to hit 50 rps on single GPU; we may recommend Dedicated pool sizing (2 gpus) to be safe.

maria (pm): next steps: kevin -> spike + doc, sophia -> infra estimation + cost delta, omar -> collect customer network + timelines. Follow-up sync Fri 16:00 UTC.

omar (sales): noted. pinging customer for network diagram now. :email: 

kevin (se): adding RDW-3219 to backlog with label onprem-intake. anyone want to add acceptance criteria?

maria (pm): acceptance criteria (short):
- end-to-end deploy in EU VPC with HSM working
- audit logs accessible and searchable
- sustained 50 rps validated under perf test
- runbook + rollback steps in repo

sophia (eng): + perf thresholds and SLO doc

omar (sales): thanks team. will update customer. :thumbsup:
